newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Spain's SEPI A1 plus s-term, AA l-term.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Spain's SEPI A1 plus s-term, AA l-term.

text.p: IBCA, the European rating agency, said on Monday it affirmed the A1 plus short term and AA long term ratings of Sociedad Estatal de Participaciones Industriales (SEPI).
"The rating reflects SEPI's ability to obtain sufficient cash flow to service future interest and principal payments," IBCA said in a statement.
It said the majority of SEPI's debt was inherited from the now defunct Instituto Nacional de Industria (INI) and present indebtedness continues to carry the guarantee of the state.

Debt servicing will be funded principally from dividend income and from SEPI's ability to off-set accumulated tax losses against tax payments. The agency said Spain's new government has redefined SEPI's role to include the sale of shareholdings of public companies.

"Under present market capitalisation, SEPI's main liquid investments, which include Repsol and Endesa, cover the present indebtedness by more than three times and the planned disposals should provide considerable cash flow for debt repayment," IBCA said.
